# Copilot Instructions for CRM Application

This is a Next.js CRM application built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

## Project Overview
- Full-featured CRM system with admin and guest user authentication
- Comprehensive client management with 18 data fields
- JSON-based data storage with localStorage
- Responsive UI built with Tailwind CSS

## Key Features
- Admin login (password: admin123) with full CRUD and export capabilities
- Guest user access for basic client data entry
- Multi-select locations dropdown
- Payment tracking with multiple fields
- Agreement status and payment mode tracking

## Project Structure
- `/src/app` - Next.js App Router pages and layouts
- `/src/components` - Reusable React components
- `package.json` - Project dependencies and scripts
- `tailwind.config.ts` - Tailwind CSS configuration
- `tsconfig.json` - TypeScript configuration

## Development Commands
- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm start` - Start production server
- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 14
- React 18
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- localStorage for data persistence

## Default Credentials
- Admin Password: `admin123`
- Guest User: No password required
